entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Hemant Sharma appearing on behalf of Advocate General.

ORDER This is repeat second application filed under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023 (in short "B.N.S.S."), for grant of bail to the applicant/accused, relating to FIR/Crime No.11/2023 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station-Mahila thana Mandsuar (M.P.) for the commission of offence punishable under sections 376(D), 506 and 34 of the IPC.
Counsel for the applicant submits that criminal case has been disposed off by the trial court therefore, this bail application becomes infructuous.
In view of the aforesaid submission, MCRC is dismissed as having been rendered infructuous.

(PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA) JUDGE ajit Jafar Kala vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45634333/
